title: Rehabilitation Support Worker
description:
Looking for a Rehabilitation Support Worker role where you can make a real difference to someones everyday life?
Were looking for a caring, enthusiastic and experienced Rehabilitation Support Worker to work with a friendly male client with an acquired brain injury. Youll help him work towards his recovery goals, enjoy new experiences and make the most of life at home and in the local community click apply for full job details

title: Relief Support Worker
description:
We would love to hear from people who have the genuine passion and drive to want to make a positive difference in people's lives who have learning disabilities and mental health support needs living in our supported living service in Barrow, Cumbria.
The successful candidate will be supporting individuals at our beautiful and homely Supported Living Service in Barrow and out in the community click apply for full job details
